Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Specification for Electric Hot Air Oven DESCRIPTION : ELECTRIC HOT AIR OVEN (MEMMERT TYPE TRIPLE WALLED) WITH 2 SIDES HEATING EL EMENTS, DIGITAL TEMPERATURE CONTROLLER CUM INDICAT OR AND AIR CIRCULATION FAN, CHAMBER SIZ E: 36 INCH (H) X 24 INCH (W) X 24 I NCH (D), RATING: 4000 WATTS CONSTRUCTION : Triple walled construction. Inner chamber should be made of heavy gauge stainless ste el of (AISI 304) sheet. Outer chamber should be made of mild steel sheet, finished by powder coat paint in attractive colour. Middle chambers should be made of mild steel finished with heat resistant aluminum p ai nts. The gap between outer and middle walls should be filled with superfine glass wool for proper insulati o n and to avoid heat losses thereby saving energy. Inner chamber should be provided ribs for placing the s helves at convenient levels. SHELVES : Removable shelves made of stainless steel with adjustable height. Should be supplied with 3 n os of removable shelves. DOOR : Double walled front door with high-grade glass wool insulation and fitted with gasket to prevent e nergy losses and knob on the outside for easy opening and closing. Fitted with heavy casted chrome plate d hinges with a ball catcher spring load door closing device ELEMENTS : Tubular air heating elements should be made of high grade nichrome wires, which should b e evenly distributed on 2 sides of the intermediate (middle) chamber for uniform temperature all over the space. DIGITAL TEMPERATURE CONTROL : Should be controlled and indicated by digital temperature control l er from 50°C to 250°C. Also the unit should be provided with low, medium and high heater selector switch . Ventilator should be placed on the top to remove hot gases and fumes. AIR CIRCULATION : The unit should be provided with forced air circulation fan to obtain uniform temper a ture throughout the chamber. CONTROL PANEL : The control panel should be fitted on the top / side of the oven consisting of: • Switch es for mains on / off • Toggle switch for air circulation fan • Indicators for mains, heaters and fan • 3 way h eater selector switch • Digital temperature controller cum indicator. POWER: 230 volts, single phase, 50 Hz AC supply. Calibration Certificate to be Traceable to National and I nternational Standards should be provided with the Equipment. The supplier should be OEM or authorized

agency of OEM and relevant certificates should be s ubmitted. TERMS & CONDITIONS 1. Instruction Manual : The Supplier should provide Instruction manual, regarding operation, maintenan ce. 2. Warranty period : Minimum one year from the date of receipt of the equipment. 3. Authorization Certificate : Authorization certificate, issued by the OEM authorizing selling of offered prod uct, should be submitted along with the tender. 4. Delivery : Preferably Ex-stock within 2 to 3 weeks. 5. After Sales Service : The Supplier should clearly spell out in the offer, the facilities available with him or his local agent for providing adequate after sales service. 6. Inspection : By consignee at consignee's premises. 7. Price : Price should be quoted F.O.R. Destination. 8. Note : The offer should be complete in all respects and specifically spell out the details and deviations if any. The information furnished in the catalogue/literature will not be taken into cognizance unless and ot h erwise a specific reference is made to this effect in the quotation. The Supplier should furnish his remarks f or all the technical details in the specification. 09. Bidder should confirm the Specification by uploading duly signed and stamped ATC along with the Bid.
